name: Femme Osage Creek
places: August A. Busch Memorial Conservation Area
about: The Femme Osage Creek watershed covers about 70 square miles of St. Charles County. It is made up of 3 smaller watersheds: Callaway Fork, Schluersburg Creek-Femme Osage Creek and Femme Osage Creek. Click one to open it. The land ranges from about 890 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 460 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Femme Osage Creek, Callaway Fork, Little Femme Osage Creek and Schluersburg Creek. This area includes part of New Melle. All of its water ends up in the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
